data.name: Ehtaraamun
data.gender_notes: Ehtaraamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To be treated with respect, dignity and honor. The name Ehtaraamun carries the meaning “Respect, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ehtaraamun usually hope their child will grow to embody respect, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being treated with respect and dignity in all aspects of life, both from others and oneself
data.etymology: Ehtaraamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Respect, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ehtaraamun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إحترام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من فعل 'أحترم'، يعني تقدير واحترام الشخص لآخرين، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القيم الإسلامية العالية مثل الاحترام والتقدير والتواضع. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الاحترام في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وإذا سلمتم فلا تدخلوا من قبلها حتى يؤذن لكم' (سورة الأحزاب: 53)، مما يشير إلى أهمية الاحترام في التعامل مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: احترام
in_urdu.meaning: احترام کسی کے لئے، عزت دینا، توقیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام 'احترام' کے معنی میں ہے، جو عربی زبان کے 'أحترم' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کسی شخص کی عزت کرنا، ان کی توقیر کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ احترام اور توقیر دوسروں کے لئے بہت ضروری ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں بھی احترام کے موضوع پر مختلف آیات موجود ہیں، جیسے: 'وإذا سلمتم فلا تدخلوا من قبلها حتى يؤذن لكم' (سورة الأحزاب: 53)

in_hindi.name: आदर
in_hindi.meaning: किसी का सम्मान करना, आदर देना
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम 'आदर' के अर्थ में है, जो अरबी भाषा के 'أحترم' क्रिया से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है किसी व्यक्ति का सम्मान करना, उनकी इज्जत करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि सम्मान और आदर दूसरों के लिए बहुत आवश्यक है। कुरआन में भी सम्मान के विषय पर विभिन्न आयतें हैं, जैसे: 'और जब तुम (किसी के घर) आओ, तो अपने घरवालों को सलाम करो, फिर (उनसे) अभिवादन करो।' (अल-अहजाब: ५३)

in_pashto.name: احترام
in_pashto.meaning: د بل چا لپاره عزت، درناوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د 'احترام' په معنی دی، چی د عربی ژبی د 'أحترم' فعل نه اخیستی دی. دا مطلب دی چی یو چا ته عزت ورکول، د هغه درناوی کول. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې ډیر اهمیت لري ځکه چی عزت او درناوی بل چا ته ډیر ضروری دی. قرآن کریم کې هم د احترام موضوع باندی مختلف آیات موجود دي، لكه: 'او كله چې تاسو (كسي كور) ته راشئ، نو خپلو كورنيو ته سلام وكوئ، بیا (د هغوی نه) استقبال وكوئ.' (الاحزاب: ٥٣)

in_english.name: Ehtaraamun
in_english.meaning: Respect, honor, and dignity to others
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ehtaraamun is derived from the Arabic root 'aḥtaram', which means to respect, honor, or dignify others. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant value as it reflects the importance of treating others with respect and dignity. The Quran mentions respect in various verses, such as: 'When you enter a house, salute your host, then ask leave; if you find no one, do not enter until permission is given; if you are asked to withdraw, withdraw; that is more proper for you.' (Al-Ahzab: 53)

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the concept of Ehtaraam revolves around the idea of showing respect and kindness to all living beings, be it human or animal. It is considered essential to uphold the value of Ehtaraam to build harmonious relationships and maintain peace and tranquility within society. This respect extends to treating the elderly, individuals with disabilities, and babies with love, care, and attention. In essence, the practice of Ehtaraam serves as a reminder for Muslims to treat others with empathy and dignity, fostering a compassionate and inclusive community.
data.spiritual_significance: Ehtaraam also holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam, as it is an essential aspect of pleasing Allah (God) and adhering to His commandments. Muslims believe that treating others with respect and dignity is a part of their faith and serves as a reflection of their devotion to Allah. Moreover, it is perceived as an act of worship that helps purify one's heart and soul, drawing them closer to their Creator. The prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength. The strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." By practicing Ehtaraam, Muslims can cultivate patience, restraint, and self-control, as well as nurture the internal qualities of love, compassion, and humility, thus drawing them closer to their divine connection with Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Respect, Honor" symbolizes To be treated with respect, dignity and honor. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ehtaraamun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of respect, honor.
